items.name: middleware-next
items.title: Next.js Route Handler Wrapper
items.description: Route-handler wrapper (withAmplio) that owns the request wide event - this is not Next.js middleware.ts.
items.docs: Wrap route handlers: `export const GET = withAmplio(handler)`. In a create-t3-app layout, `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha init --wire` edits src/app/api/trpc/[trpc]/route.ts for you.

items.name: middleware-fastify
items.description: Fastify plugin that attaches request-scoped amplio context.

items.name: middleware-trpc
items.title: tRPC Middleware
items.description: tRPC middleware that annotates the ambient request wide event with trpc fields (pair with the Next.js route-handler wrapper).
items.docs: Wire into your procedure bases: `const amplioMiddleware = t.middleware(amplioTrpcMiddleware())` then `.use(amplioMiddleware)` on publicProcedure/protectedProcedure. In a create-t3-app layout, `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha init --wire` edits src/server/api/trpc.ts for you.

items.name: sink-console
items.description: Console sink that prints wide events as JSON.
items.docs: Wire the sink: add `import { consoleSink } from "./sinks/console"` to telemetry/logger.ts and append `consoleSink` to the init() sinks array. Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add sink console` — it wires logger.ts for you.

items.name: sink-json
items.description: JSON sink that serializes wide events for streaming or files.
items.docs: Wire the sink: add `import { jsonFileSink } from "./sinks/json"` to telemetry/logger.ts and append `jsonFileSink()` to the init() sinks array; add amplio.jsonl to .gitignore. Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add sink json` — it wires all of this for you.

items.name: sink-otlp
items.description: OTLP sink that exports wide events over OpenTelemetry.
items.docs: Wire the sink: add `import { otlpSink } from "./sinks/otlp"` to telemetry/logger.ts and append `otlpSink()` to the init() sinks array; set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT (or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT) in your env. Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add sink otlp` — it wires logger.ts for you.
